exposure: Women's self-reported recall of maternal and newborn care received during the intrapartum and immediate postnatal period
cohort: The study included 606 women who delivered in two Kenyan hospitals, with 515 re-interviewed at follow-up.
finding: Indicators accurately reported by women at baseline were consistently recalled with accuracy at 13-15 months follow-up, despite some deterioration in recall for other indicators over time.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was one of four indicators that women reported accurately at follow-up.
